verdict.rationale: Steel's Agent Traces turn a run into a step-by-step timeline of agent activity that you can review without scrubbing the full recording. Runs can be exported as markdown, JSON, or a ZIP with screenshots. The docs also list session replays as a core feature, and a dedicated Session Debugging skill and Traces API exist. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of video replay playback (only implied by 'recording' and 'session replays'), explicit failure-diagnosis workflow detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
